pairs.why: Nearly identical watches with the same smooth gold and clean face; A's softer contact shadow is offset by B's slightly crisper rim, so neither is clearly closer.
A's rim has softer, rounder gold highlights and the watch is a bit bigger in the frame, slightly closer to the chunky, soft-lit objects on the real cards.
The two are almost pixel-identical in finish, color and shape; the only differences are minor framing.
B's gold is a slightly cleaner, more even satin with less harsh specular hotspots, nearer the soft plastic-gold of the real coin and charms.
A's warmer face and slightly painted serif numerals read a bit more textured, while B stays clean and crisp like the real cards.
The rendering, color and build are essentially the same; only the tilt differs slightly.
A has a chunkier, rounder rim with a soft shadow beneath it, a touch closer to the plump, toy-like objects on the real cards.
Both are equally smooth, saturated and well built, with no meaningful difference in finish.
